newsitem.title: POLAND: Man unit builds Polish bus factory.
newsitem.headline: Man unit builds Polish bus factory.

text.p: MAN Nutzfahrzeuge, a unit of Germany's MAN AG, on Tuesday began the contruction of a bus assembly factory in Poland, PAP news agency reported.

The 23 million mark factory, based near the western city of Poznan, will initially assemble 120 buses annually and employ 250 people. The output would then be expanded to 600 buses annualy and the employment to 900 workers, PAP said.
The first buses will roll off the plant's assembly line in the first half of 1998, it said.
PAP quoted MAN's management board member Franz Breun as saying that his company counted on orders of the Polish cities, which badly needed to replace about 50 percent of municipal transport buses.
The plant will be built by the Polish construction company Budimex.
